verdict.rationale: Obsidian publishes an official TypeScript plugin API (obsidian-api, including the Vault interface) and developer docs with a build-a-plugin tutorial. One community report confirms using that API to extract metadata. However, the SDK only covers in-app plugins in TypeScript, and the evidence shows no official SDKs in other languages and no SDK for driving Obsidian or its services from outside the app. missing for 10: official SDKs beyond the in-app TypeScript plugin API (e.g. external/programmatic SDKs for agents or services), multi-language SDK coverage, AI/agent-oriented SDK documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
